Six test files (T1-T6) + conftest fixtures map exit leg L1 (evidence pack ready): 10 categories fail-closed, 18-smoke registry complete, gap/blocker list always carries the 8 standing blockers (but they do not force NOT_READY), pack never declares Pass/Ready and reaches OWNER_REVIEW_REQUIRED only when complete, posture immutable + PII-safe, carried 18-smoke suite present + collectable. Every change-set item maps to leg L1 and carries a rollback step (new files -> delete; no carried-forward file patched). Sole in-scope rule RULE-015 + sole fail gate FAIL-007 cited by ID. NO new migration (RULE-018) and NO new config flag. RAN AN ADVERSARIAL SELF-REVIEW (ultracode; 7 agents, 3 dimensions, each finding re-verified by an independent skeptic RUNNING the code): the no-self-cert/no-Pass-Ready/scope/schema dimension came back CLEAN (no Pass/Ready method, readiness tops at OWNER_REVIEW_REQUIRED, no new table, assembly-only); FOUR CONFIRMED findings FIXED -- (MAJOR, a genuine fail-open) the owner-waiver escape hatch was unscoped: SmokeResult.recorded honored waived=True for ANY smoke, so a MANDATORY owner smoke could be waived un-run, bypassing the fail-closed readiness gate and vanishing from the gap list (FAIL-007 defeated for the 15 mandatory smokes) -> FIXED by enforcing waiver scope in the assembler (a non-proposed smoke's waiver is stripped -> stays un-run -> UNRUN_SMOKE gap + NOT_READY), plus a REGRESSION; (NIT) the recorded posture snapshot was a mutable dict on a frozen dataclass (could be tampered in-memory) -> wrapped in MappingProxyType (read-only), plus a REGRESSION; (NIT) SMK-017 scenario/expected dropped '(CAPI/Offline)' + 'platform' vs SMOKE_REGISTER -> restored verbatim. No plan-deltas. STATUS is coder SELF-REPORTED (not a gate/judge sign-off, RULE-015); the runner gate + JUDGE decide, and the M6.2K exit gate M6-P2009 checks the legs (evidence pack ready: full P0 re-run with correlation_id+evidence_id, all 10 §22 categories with mandatory content, owner package + honest gap/blocker list; every-prompt evidence; rollback).
